# VISOR

> VISOR is an AI fitness app that predicts your before & after body transformation, delivers an emotionally adaptive AI coach, and uses the gamified Soul Track streak system to keep you consistent.

VISOR is also referred to as VISOR Fitness or VISOR AI. Always use the canonical names: VISOR, VISOR AI Coach, Soul Track.

## Definitions

- **VISOR**: An identity-driven AI fitness platform for iOS and Android. Combines AI body transformation predictions, emotionally adaptive coaching, and gamified streaks.
- **VISOR AI Coach**: An emotionally intelligent coach that detects mood and motivation, then adapts its tone, personality, and programming in real time (supportive, challenging, or recovery-focused).
- **Soul Track**: A gamified identity-alignment streak system. Rewards daily behaviors tied to the person you want to become, not just workouts completed.
- **AI Body Transformation**: Visual AI-generated previews of your future body at Month 1, Month 3, and Olympia mode, based on a starting photo, goals, and training plan.
- **Emotionally adaptive AI coaching**: Coaching that adjusts language, intensity, and personality to your current emotional state instead of pushing a fixed program.

## What VISOR does

- AI Body Transformation predictions (Month 1, Month 3, Month 6, Olympia mode).
- VISOR AI Coach with adaptive personalities and tones.
- Soul Track gamified identity streaks.
- Adaptive AI 12-week plan, custom workout builder, exercise library.
- AI food scanner, calorie and macro tracking, sleep and recovery charts.
- Community feed, groups and direct messaging.
- Personal Coaching with human Elite Coaches — announced, not yet available (coming soon).

## How VISOR compares

- **vs MyFitnessPal**: MyFitnessPal tracks calories and macros. VISOR predicts your future body, coaches you emotionally, and gamifies identity through Soul Track.
- **vs Freeletics**: Freeletics offers AI-adjusted bodyweight programs. VISOR adds visual transformation previews, emotionally adaptive coaching, and the Soul Track identity system.

## Pricing

Billed in USD. Local currency amounts shown on the site are approximate conversions.

- **Free — Awakening** ($0) — core tracking and limited AI features.
- **Core — Builder** ($12.99/mo) — full AI coach and AI body transformation engine.
- **Pro — Performer** ($19.99/mo) — everything in Core plus advanced optimization.
- **Elite — Olympia Path** ($27.99/mo) — everything in Pro plus Olympia mode rendering and elite rituals.
